events_place_check.name: events_place_check
events_place_check.value:
("events"."mode" = 'online' and "events"."online_url" is not null)
        or ("events"."mode" = 'in_person' and "events"."venue_id" is not null)
        or ("events"."mode" = 'hybrid' and "events"."venue_id" is not null and "events"."online_url" is not null)

ticket_types_sale_window_check.name: ticket_types_sale_window_check
ticket_types_sale_window_check.value: "ticket_types"."sales_start_at" is null or "ticket_types"."sales_end_at" is null or "ticket_types"."sales_end_at" > "ticket_types"."sales_start_at"

venues_geo_check.name: venues_geo_check
venues_geo_check.value:
("venues"."latitude" is null) = ("venues"."longitude" is null)
        and ("venues"."latitude" is null or ("venues"."latitude" between -90 and 90 and "venues"."longitude" between -180 and 180))
